scope: Python declaration bodies, syntax provenance and declared check execution
requirements: Locate each same-line call through its authoring IR pointer and exact Unicode source span.
Represent synthesized nodes and combined source origins without fabricated positions.
Retain rule, source, analyzer and semantic identities; bounded pages do not establish absence.
Bind executed checks to workspace and check configuration inputs before completing a task step.
Preserve failed checks, tool identity output and coverage limits; reject stale or tampered retained evidence.
claims: Deterministic finite acceptance; no compiler type inference, source equivalence proof or live-agent claim.
direct_edit_boundary: New provenance mapping and report adapters exceed the existing admitted structural authoring operations.
